name: compression_tree
description: LZSS match-tree node deletion, child relinking, node transplantation and predecessor traversal compiled together with native LTCG. The recursive deletion entry is rooted to preserve ECX; its real calls establish the helper register conventions. Only the four complete retail function contributions count as recovered code.

functions.name: Lzss_RemoveNode
functions.actual_abi: node in ECX; no result; plain RET

functions.name: CompressionTree_RelinkChild
functions.actual_abi: source in ESI; replacement in EDX; plain RET

functions.name: CompressionTree_ReplaceNode
functions.actual_abi: source in EAX; replacement in ECX; no result; plain RET

functions.name: CompressionTree_FindPredecessor
functions.actual_abi: node in EAX; result in EAX; plain RET
